exclusion_reason: Scania histogram mass can be fractional and has no validated iid observation-count interpretation
conditions: all retained split totals available to every method: six regular known, ALPI and WMCS unknown
threshold: epsilon_k = effect + sqrt(log(2*K*(2**M-2)/alpha)/(2*nL_k)) + sqrt(log(2*K*(2**M-2)/alpha)/(2*nR_k)); known totals use actual counts, unknown use core lower counts
scope: null guarantee assumes independent categorical observations (or uniform permutation); real sensor results are a threshold sensitivity and do not verify the iid assumption
